column1: # need_mib is the GPU memory the engine reported at load, MEASURED on the Strix Halo box on 7 Oct 2026 from
# its own line:  [loader] event=load_completed ... context_tokens=131072 ... gpu_device_used_mib=35285
# of gpu_device_total_mib=122880. Weights are about 22.5 GiB by the model card; the rest is the snapshot
# cache, which the engine configured at capacity_bytes=34359738368 for two sessions.
# Native context is 262144 (the fork's own model page); 131072 is what this pack needs and what was measured.
# YaRN extension is unsupported and not needed. draft_tokens is the engine's own cap (1-7); the draft length
# adapts to acceptance, and 49 of 68 drafted tokens were accepted on the first probe.
